description: We are DOWNTOWN, a passionate team of technology enthusiasts who love programming, innovation, and problem-solving. Our goal is to develop a smart health monitoring solution for astronauts during space missions. We value teamwork, creativity, and continuous learning. We are looking for motivated members interested in software development, coding, AI, data analysis, healthcare, and space science to build something impactful together!
summary: AstroGuard is a clinical decision-support platform designed for deep-space missions. It monitors astronaut health in real time and provides autonomous medical triage when communication delays with Earth make live doctor consultations impossible.
details: How it works: The crew inputs their symptoms (like vision changes or back pain) alongside diagnostic scans, such as retinal OCT or ultrasound images. Our backend processes these inputs alongside live biometric telemetry, cross-referencing them against NASA’s Human Research Program (HRP) risk matrices. Using a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipeline, it pulls the right clinical countermeasures—like recommending -30 mmHg LBNP decompression—and automatically formats a standardized SBAR medical report for ground control.
